integrity_notes: Exact two-variable proof via a fixed transfer-matrix identity, a reversible pendant-path extension, finite seed enumeration, and induction.
Independent exhaustive edge-subset checks are reproducibility tests, not substitutes for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Only a single pendant path on a single cycle is covered; the general connected-graph conjecture is not proved.
The bivariate recurrence concerns counts of all perfect edge dominating sets, not minimum cardinalities.
The bibliographic novelty assessment is not an exhaustive survey of unpublished/unindexed sources.
title: A strict cycle bound for perfect edge domination on tadpole graphs
